name: Kin Audio
mission: Open, content-preserving neural audio re-instrumentation: the musician authors the performance; the model changes its body.
current_focus: Ingest a leakage-safe StarNet subset and establish real-audio baselines.
principles: Preservation claims require held-out measurements and listening examples.
Code, data, and model weights carry independent explicit licenses.
Training runs are reproducible from a pinned configuration and dataset version.
No proprietary sample library enters a public dataset or released model without permission.

milestones.name: Reproducible research core
milestones.evidence: End-to-end smoke run trained, inferred, and measured 2.1-cent median pitch error with 97.4% voicing overlap.

milestones.name: Open-data baseline
milestones.evidence: StarNet is the first paired benchmark; its CC BY 4.0 provenance and composition-level split are registered.

milestones.name: Niche target body
milestones.evidence: First intended release is monophonic performance to a choir-like learned body.

milestones.name: Polyphonic transfer
milestones.evidence: Paired MIDI rendering and WaveTransfer provide the initial path.
